mcift_exchange_pipeline.sigma_scale_rule: 1.4826*MAD when >1e-12; otherwise population standard deviation when >1e-12; otherwise 1.0

matrix.normalization: no post-construction normalization; Gaussian and cosine-squared terms bound off-diagonal values to [0,1] for g=1

mcift_exchange_pipeline.densification: exp(eta*mean(M_ij for i<j)); calculated by adapter but not used in IMS score
mcift_exchange_pipeline.healthy_reference_matrix: elementwise median of the 98 reference exchange matrices
mcift_exchange_pipeline.config_label_correction: The config says Frobenius distance, but executed code computes upper-triangle RMS. This export follows code.

missing_data_policy.missing_recording_file: Fails if discovered file count is not exactly 984; no skip or imputation.
missing_data_policy.empty_file: np.loadtxt or the exact-shape check fails; run stops.
missing_data_policy.malformed_row: np.loadtxt or the exact-shape check fails; run stops.
missing_data_policy.nan: No explicit raw-input check. np.loadtxt accepts NaN; downstream behavior is partition- and operation-dependent, with no warning or imputation policy.
missing_data_policy.positive_or_negative_infinity: No explicit raw-input check. Values may propagate or trigger MCIFT reference-scale validation; no uniform policy exists.
missing_data_policy.wrong_waveform_sample_count: Exact shape (20480, 4) check fails; run stops.
missing_data_policy.duplicate_timestamp: No validation. Timestamp is an unparsed filename string; duplicate strings would continue as separate rows.
missing_data_policy.out_of_order_timestamp: Paths are lexicographically sorted; timestamps are not parsed or checked. No explicit temporal reorder policy exists.
missing_data_policy.unexpected_column_count: Exact shape (20480, 4) check fails; run stops.
missing_data_policy.zero_variance_recording: No rejection. RMS, peak-to-peak, crest factor, entropy, and band energy become zero, but SciPy kurtosis becomes NaN; downstream conventional score can become NaN. MCIFT has explicit scale/zero-power fallbacks.
missing_data_policy.partially_readable_file: If parsing or exact shape fails, run stops; there is no partial-record continuation path.
missing_data_policy.logging: No warning-only malformed-input path is implemented.
